answer: One control decides whether a farm gets in, and it is Transit observer chronometer night record stamped by the time service — each chronometer is a dated night log plus a signed rating sheet, so a farm must. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 654 fakes pay 654 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill outruns its reward. Without a wharf there is no proof, without a relic there is no deterrent, and without a harbor there is no audit. Faking one identity is a project; faking a hundred is a bankruptcy.
